gallery_items_user_checksum_uidx.name: gallery_items_user_checksum_uidx
gallery_items_user_checksum_uidx.where: "gallery_items"."checksum" is not null and "gallery_items"."deleted_at" is null

orders_live_intent_uniq.name: orders_live_intent_uniq
orders_live_intent_uniq.where: our_status = 'pending' AND intent_key IS NOT NULL

script_assist_requests_free_cluster_uidx.name: script_assist_requests_free_cluster_uidx
script_assist_requests_free_cluster_uidx.where: "script_assist_requests"."op" = 'structurize_free' AND "script_assist_requests"."free_cluster_key" IS NOT NULL AND "script_assist_requests"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'aborted')

projects_trash_state_check.name: projects_trash_state_check
projects_trash_state_check.value:
("projects"."deleted_at" is null and "projects"."purge_after" is null and "projects"."trash_manifest" is null)
        or ("projects"."deleted_at" is not null and (
          ("projects"."purge_after" is null and "projects"."trash_manifest" is null)
          or ("projects"."purge_after" is not null and "projects"."trash_manifest" is not null)
        ))
